_comment: The raw properties object of the `permission.asked` bus event emitted by a REAL opencode 2.0.27 serve, CAPTURED LIVE — not read out of a binary. Obtained by POSTing /api/session/:sessionID/permission {"action":"edit","resources":["/tmp/orchicon-perm-probe2.txt"]} and reading the event off /api/event. THE SHAPE IS DIFFERENT FROM 1.x and that difference was the reported bug: the class is `action` (1.x: `permission`), the paths are `resources` (1.x: `patterns` + `metadata.filepath`), and there is NO `metadata`, NO `tool`/{messageID,callID} reference and no `title`. Every 1.x candidate key missed, so the card rendered its no-noun fallback ('use the tool') with no path, and keyed on the scope directory an Ask conversation does not have — which printed as '.'.
